intent.what: GDEX preview: exact executable terms for an explicit trade intent, bound to GDEX managed custody; nothing submitted.

paper_fill.what: Simulated fill of the intent's size at the HyperLiquid mid for the coin at the observation instant. Self-asserted by this tool; not a chain event.
paper_fill.fee_model: none (paper; the preview reports no fee; a LIVE fill carries the chain's fee)

actor.rule: actor_id is the GDEX managed EVM wallet the preview binds to; the control wallet (if given) only signed the session in.

dispute_semantics.meaning: A dispute fires when the paper fill price deviates from the preview's quote price by more than max_quote_to_fill_bps. It records that the intent's terms were not reproducible at the fill instant - NOT that any number was falsified.
